description: Boot-smoke milestone baselines. Owner decision 22 (2026-09-18) replaced the self-tracking `190 + 2 x transport sectors` menu identity with two independent numbers: an absolute ceiling that states the owner's real budget, and a delta against the baseline below. The 2026-09-20 re-basing applies the same shape to the `loader` milestone, which until then was gated only by accident through a hard-coded frame-300 observation point in the boot smoke. Re-record `baseline` deliberately, in the same commit as the change that grows the transport on purpose, and state the reason in the commit message.

recorded.reason: Re-recorded for Light multiplicity step 1a, the first step that puts real content in owner decision X's code window at $B600-$BBFF. The Light C - tick, admission, reload, schedule and hit - left HYBRID_C_EXT for the window, which is the tenth DFMC record: transport 195 -> 197 sectors (the window record is 4 sectors LZ, 590 B raw / 434 B packed, and the extension shrank by 2 sectors). MEASURED from a full 8-session boot smoke, 8/8 passed. ATR milestones move +4/+4 (loader 319 -> 323, menu 576 -> 580) and XEX -1/-1 (135 -> 134, 392 -> 391): every one inside the +10 warn band, so this is a re-record of a change that was cheaper than the band, not of one that spent it. The XEX milestones move at all only because the boot image shifted; the binary loader still places every block before the start milestone. gameplay_init stays at frame 3060 on ATR against 3053 on XEX, the level image at $A600 still compares byte-exact against build/level-1.bin, and command frames stay XEX 0 / ATR 2 with 0 retries. The window read-back changed shape with this step: it used to compare the retired 16-byte inert probe and now compares the first 16 bytes of the linked kernel image, which is the same proof over real content.
